title: Migrate old game exports to server-log-based format
description: The 17 existing game exports in website/public/games/ use the old spectator-based format (version 1, no version field). They should be migrated to the new server-log-based format (version 2) as best as possible. Some data like full hand contents, P/T on permanents, mana pools, and visible_to annotations won't be recoverable from spectator logs. After migration, remove support for the old spectator format from export_game.py.
